spiritgiven.comments: They used calls to create an advantage for them and had no clear line with their body contact. During calls, multiple times, players on and of the pitch involved them without being asked.

spiritreceived.comments: very spiritual game. they had great communication with us both on the sideline and in the game.
Thank you germany for the great game, good luck for the rest of the tournament :)
many calls seemed to be done in benefit to an outcome

A lot of unnecessary contact that was at times dangerous and could have resolved in injuries. The communication was heated from time to time and players that weren't involved in the calls involved themselves fairly often even though your captain pointed out before the game, that you didn't want that. To add to this we felt that the some calls towards the end of the game when the score got tighter, the calls got more frequent and weren't consistent in comparison to the beginning.

Several instances of avoidable contact after points were scored. Lots of aggression from one player in particular who was not willing to listen to apologies after minor, incidental contact. Their coach also showed poor self control.

We did talk to the captains about the spirit before the game and they agreed to concern about the contact and avoid body check as much as they can and only do it in case to agree  with the matchup.
But we felt they continued doing it constantly, we also have to improve making the calls

We felt that there were a lot of unnecessary bids and body contact which definitely could have been avoided. Otherwise, the communication and talking out about the calls made were very good, listening to both opinions from both sides, and then coming to a conclusion. And they also listened to each others opinions from sidelines, then even uncontesting or retracting. Also a lot of high fives and smiles on the sidelines. Thank you Germany for the game!
